plain: To lower oneself to do something one thinks is beneath one.

webster.text: To think worthy; to vouchsafe; to condescend.

example.quote: The most plausible of these, who has appeared in print, has even deigned to admit that the election of the President is pretty well guarded.(1) I venture somewhat further, and hesitate not to affirm, that if the manner of it be not perfect, it is at least excellent.
